_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits mid-Anxiety band with no breaker; base rate favors coil, so HOLD toward Complacency unless flows/F&G shift.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly HOLD→Complacency; narrative is positioning-risk only and does not call a forward phase, so no full agreement on path
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC continues to chop with F&G stuck ~45-55 and ETF flows near zero without a range break
next_move.invalidated_if: Downside flush (F&G into the 30s, longs unwind) back into deeper Anxiety/Panic, or flow/liquidity impulse lifts F&G through ~60 and reclaims range toward Disbelief
